$comment: Reviewed CFB identities for programs that have not yet appeared in any identity-verified game of the CFB publication (so scripts/teams/fetch-cfb-teams.mjs could not learn them from a verified pair). Each entry is the Kalshi/contract team code and its ESPN team id. A later verified pair that disagrees fails the fetch (mergePairs conflict) instead of silently winning, so a mistake here can never stick.

MICH.why: Michigan Wolverines: ESPN team id 130; contract code MICH (Big Ten). Absent from the 2026-10-08 publication's verified games.

ALBY.why: UAlbany Great Danes (University at Albany, FCS, CAA football): ESPN team id 399, the same id SIFT's committed CBB identity carries for UAlbany (src/lib/cbb-teams.json, name 'UAlbany'). Contract code ALBY (Kalshi 26OCT17ALBYSTON, yes label 'University at Albany'). The Script Engine could not identity-verify the game (FCS), so no verified pair exists.

DSU.why: Delaware State Hornets (FCS, MEAC): ESPN team id 2169, contract code DSU (Kalshi 26OCT23NCCUDSU, yes label 'Delaware St.'). The CFB publication's own Script Engine identity check passed for this game (identity.status PASS, espn_event_id 401867955) and names the home team 'Delaware State', team_id 2169 (away: North Carolina Central, 2428), but the Kalshi participant rows carry no short_name, so no code<->id pair was learned from them. Canonical SIFT name: 'Delaware State' (ESPN's name; the publication's 'Delaware St.' is its abbreviation).
